shortDescription: Manage node pools in Kubernetes kubernetes cluster

options.name: ad_user
options.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: adfs_authority_url
options.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

options.name: api_profile
options.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of C(latest) is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack.

options.name: append_tags
options.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object's metadata.

options.name: auth_source
options.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the C(ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE) environment variable. When set to C(auto) (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> C(env) -> C(credential_file) -> C(cli). When set to C(env), the credentials will be read from the environment variables. When set to C(credential_file), it will read the profile from C(~/.azure/credentials). When set to C(cli), the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile

options.name: availability_zones
options.description: Availability zones for nodes. Must use VirtualMachineScaleSets AgentPoolType.

options.name: capacity_reservation_group_id
options.description: The Capacity Reservation Group ID.

options.name: cert_validation_mode
options.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing C(ignore). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION) environment variable.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the C(AZURE_CLIENT_ID) environment variable.

options.name: cloud_environment
options.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, C(AzureChinaCloud), C(AzureUSGovernment)), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT) environment variable.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The name of the kubernetes cluster.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of agents (VMs) to host docker containers.

options.name: disable_instance_discovery
options.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validati

options.name: enable_auto_scaling
options.description: Whether to enable auto-scaler.

options.name: enable_encryption_at_host
options.description: This is only supported on certain VM sizes and in certain Azure regions.

options.name: enable_fips
options.description: Whether enable FIPS node pool.

options.name: enable_node_public_ip
options.description: Some scenarios may require nodes in a node pool to receive theirown dedicated public IP addresses. A common scenario is for gaming workloads, where a console needs to make a direct connection to a cloud virtual machine to minimize hops.

options.name: enable_ultra_ssd
options.description: Whether to enable UltraSSD.

options.name: gpu_instance_profile
options.description: GPUInstanceProfile to be used to specify GPU MIG instance profile for supported GPU VM SKU.

options.name: host_group_id
options.description: The Host Group ID. Sample as C(/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{RG_Name}/providers/Microsoft.Compute/hostGroups/{hostGroupName)

options.name: kubelet_config
options.description: The Kubelet configuration on the agent pool nodes.

options.name: kubelet_disk_type
options.description: Determines the placement of emptyDir volumes, container runtime data root, and Kubelet ephemeral storage.

options.name: linux_os_config
options.description: The OS configuration of Linux agent nodes.

options.name: log_mode
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: max_count
options.description: Maximum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

options.name: max_pods
options.description: Maximum number of pods that can run on a node.

options.name: min_count
options.description: Minimum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

options.name: mode
options.description: AgentPoolMode represents mode of an agent pool.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the node agent pool.

options.name: network_profile
options.description: Network-related settings of an agent pool.

options.name: node_labels
options.description: Agent pool node labels to be persisted across all nodes in agent pool.

options.name: node_public_ip_prefix_id
options.description: The Azure Public IP prefix's ID.

options.name: node_taints
options.description: The taints added to new nodes during node pool create and scale. For example as example, value:NoSchedule'.

options.name: oidc_token
options.description: Direct OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. This token is exchanged with Azure AD using OIDC federated identity. Useful in CI systems (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) where an OIDC token is provided directly by the platform. Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: oidc_token_file_path
options.description: Path to a file containing an OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. The file must contain only raw token. This method is commonly used in platforms that materialize OIDC tokens as files Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE) environment variable.

options.name: orchestrator_version
options.description: Version of orchestrator specified when creating the managed cluster.

options.name: os_disk_size_gb
options.description: OS Disk Size in GB to be used to specify the disk size for every machine in this master/agent pool.

options.name: os_disk_type
options.description: The default is C(Ephemeral) if the VM supports it and has a cache disk larger than the requested OSDiskSizeGB. Otherwise, defaults to C(Managed). May not be changed after creation.

options.name: os_sku
options.description: Specifies an OS SKU. This value must not be specified if OSType is Windows. The I(os_sku=CBLMariner) deprecated. Microsoft recommends that new deployments choose 'AzureLinux' instead.

options.name: os_type
options.description: OsType to be used to specify os type.

options.name: password
options.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: pod_subnet_id
options.description: If omitted, pod IPs are statically assigned on the node subnet.

options.name: power_state
options.description: When an Agent Pool is first created it is initially C(Running). The Agent Pool can be stopped by setting this field to C(Stopped). A stopped Agent Pool stops all of its VMs and does not accrue billing charges. An Agent Pool can only be stopped if it is Running and provisioning state is Succeeded.

options.name: profile
options.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

options.name: proximity_placement_group_id
options.description: The ID for Proximity Placement Group.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The name of the resource group.

options.name: scale_down_mode
options.description: This also effects the cluster autoscaler behavior. If not specified, it defaults to C(Delete).

options.name: scale_set_eviction_policy
options.description: This cannot be specified unless the I(scale_set_priority=Spot). If not specified, the default is C(Delete).

options.name: scale_set_priority
options.description: The Virtual Machine Scale Set priority. If not specified, the default is C(Regular).

options.name: secret
options.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: security_profile
options.description: The security settings of an agent pool.

options.name: spot_max_price
options.description: Possible values are any decimal value greater than zero or -1. Indicates the willingness to pay any on-demand price.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the automation runbook. Use C(present) to create or update a automation runbook and use C(absent) to delete.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

options.name: tags
options.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don't allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn't support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: thumbprint
options.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in I(x509_certificate_path). Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if I(x509_certificate_path) is defined.

options.name: type_properties_type
options.description: AgentPoolType represents types of an agent pool.

options.name: upgrade_settings
options.description: Settings for upgrading the agentpool.

options.name: vm_size
options.description: Size of agent VMs

options.name: vnet_subnet_id
options.description: VNet SubnetID specifies the VNet's subnet identifier.

options.name: windows_profile
options.description: The Windows agent pool's specific profile.

options.name: workload_runtime
options.description: Determines the type of workload a node can run.

options.name: x509_certificate_path
options.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.
